thread:
amelia: Kicking off v4.0.0-rollout. Strategy: EU micro-canary 4% -> US stepped slices (10% then 25%) -> APAC warm-pool -> open. Change window 23:30-03:30 UTC. Rollback rules: 5xx >1.5% sustained 3m OR p95 >1300ms. Pin model profile=q6f8-econ. Release notes: https://redwood/release/v4.0.0

deploy-bot: [deploybot] Canary start: service=serve-api variant=v4.0.0 region=eu slices=1/25 ts=4212123470

nish: EU capacity check: 6 spare GPUs, warm-pool 30% primed. I'll throttle nightly finetune at +10m.

ops-oncall: Dashboards live. Watching p50/p95/p99, 5xx rate, GPU mem, and OOMs. Alerts set: 5xx >=1.5% -> #ops-alerts, p95 >=1300ms -> #ops-alerts. Adding transient alert for KV miss >10%.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] EU canary @7m: p95=420ms, 5xx=0.3%, gpu_mem=58% Status=GREEN

amelia: EU green. Schedule US slice 1 (10%) in 15m. APAC stays warm at 20% until US+EU stable for 1h. Note: pin embedder=5.1.2-compat in rollout manifest.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] US slice 1 start: region=us slices=1/10 ts=4212123540

deploy-bot: [deploybot] US slice 1 @5m: p95=490ms, 5xx=0.9% OK

nish: Spinning extra warm-pool for US slice 2; cache-prefill running. Warning: worker.timeout default=30s for this variant.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] US slice 2 start: slices=2/10 ts=4212123580

deploy-bot: [deploybot] US slice 2 @3m: 5xx=1.8% -> ALERT to #ops-alerts (threshold 1.5%)

ops-oncall: Pausing ramp. Initiating triage: increased 502s from async-worker and queue depth spike. If we can mitigate quickly, avoid rollback.

nish: Applying quick mitigation: async.worker.timeout=60s and runtime.batch_size=48 for region=us now. Also enabling cache.prefill to reduce cold misses. ts=4212123592

deploy-bot: [deploybot] Re-eval @3m: US slice 2 error 5xx dropped to 0.6%, p95=560ms. Alert cleared.

ops-oncall: Hold slice 2 for 20m to observe. If issues recur, rollback plan: pin affected region to v3.9.7-stable and notify statuspage.

amelia: Update release notes: note embedder pin + mitigation steps (timeout bump, batch_size override, cache prefill). Also add a small advisory about potential short-lived latency for large prompts.

infra: Confirmed APAC warm-pool at 25% standby. We'll only open APAC after US+EU stable for 60m.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] US hold continued: slices=2/10 status=HELD ts=4212123615

amelia: Final: continue staggered ramp after the hold. Ops, schedule a follow-up load test to reproduce the async queue spike. Thanks team :thumbsup:
